*2024 partial (data through April); a fuller reconciliation across DSC's several
registration systems is in progress.

Workshops cover geospatial methods, programming, reproducibility, data management,
and open science, and reach far beyond any single division. DSC also coordinates
UCLA's participation in systemwide efforts including <abbr class="term" title="An
annual UC-systemwide event on research data management skills">UC Love Data
Week</abbr> and <abbr class="term" title="An annual UC-systemwide GIS training
event">UC GIS Week</abbr>.
